name: ISKONI Desktop v1.0.6
notes:
• Custom Native Player: Replaced external embeds with a built-in direct HLS player featuring ad-free playback, precision seeking, and adaptive quality selection.
• Advanced Subtitle Engine: Prioritizes English 3 by default, saves subtitle preferences to persistent local storage across restarts, and introduces an in-player Style & Sync customizer (timing offset, font sizing, color swatches, and background opacity).
• Streamlined Streaming Pipeline: Upgraded resolvers to direct high-speed endpoints (Orion, Astra, Lyra, Hindi, CineSrc) with clean UI badges.
• UI & Performance: Cleaned redundant static server options from Settings and resolved video frame compositing handoffs.
